title: Facilities Email: Fuel / misc.

fields.to: Dennis Falcone (Incident Commander); Dr. Marguerite Delacroix (CNO)
fields.subject: Fuel / misc.
fields.body:
Quick update ahead of my 08:00 report.

Generator fuel tanks are at 88%. That's about 84 hours at full load. The second tanker is due around 09:30, and that should top us off at the full 96 hours by about 10:00. Generators are on the second-floor mezzanine of the central plant. They were checked at 05:30 with no issues.

The bulk O2 tank reads 5 days at current use. I've asked the vendor to confirm a refill window before Wednesday.

Also: Bayside Linen Service called. They want to know if they can push Wednesday's delivery to "Wednesday 3 pm or so," or if we want it brought in today. They need an answer by 09:00 to load the truck. Who signs off on linen? I don't want to make that call if it belongs to nursing or materials.

Thanks,
Roy
fields.signature:
Wesley Pruitt
Facilities Director
Mariner Bay Medical Center | Central Plant

instructorNote: This is a noise inject to see whether command stays focused. Players should see that fuel is above the 72-hour threshold and on track for 96 hours, then send the linen question to Logistics or Facilities with one line: deliver today, before transport stops. Watch for the IC or CNO spending command time on linen.
